title: Almost balanced ordered biclique covering of graphs
summary: Let $f(n,k)$ be the minimum size of a collection of bicliques such that (i) every edge of the complete graph $K_n$ is covered by at least one and at most $k$ bicliques in the collection, and (ii) for each edge $\{u,v\}$, the number of bicliques in which $u$ appears in the first class and $v$ in the second class differs by at most one from the number of bicliques in which $u$ appears in the second class and $v$ in the first class.
